text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, wata on yoga e mon ƴettir jawle yoga e hoore meh-re ; wano jattugol maa wujjugol maa ngeeynorgol ekn. Si wanaa hara ko jawle njulorɗe ɗe halduɓe welondiri e mun ; ɗen ɗon no dagoo ñaamugol duncitora. Wata yoga mon waru yoga, wata goɗɗo e mo'on kadi waru hoore-mun. Alla Laatike Hinnotooɗo on ; Harminɗo ƴiiƴe mon e jawle mon e teddule mon.
